metadata.title: Agromate
metadata.description: Smart farming solutions, market prices and weather updates for farmers.

hero.subtitle: Traditional values meet modern agriculture technology to help you grow more.

about.caption: Smart, data-driven agricultural solutions helping farmers improve yields while using fewer resources.
about.heading: We are committed to empowering farmers through <image></image> smart sustainable <muted>agricultural solutions that improve productivity and protect the land.</muted>
about.intro: We empower farmers with smart, data-driven agricultural solutions that improve crop performance, reduce resource waste and promote sustainable farming practices for long-term success.

precision.title: Precision Farming
precision.description: GPS-guided equipment and sensors for accurate field management and resource allocation.

irrigation.title: Smart Irrigation Systems
irrigation.description: Sensor-driven sprinklers give each zone the right amount of water, right when crops need it.

monitoring.title: Pest & Disease Monitoring
monitoring.description: Field sensors and weather stations flag pest and disease risks before they spread.

machinery.title: Autonomous Machinery
machinery.description: Self-driving sprayers and tractors handle repetitive work with steady precision.

whyChoose.featureText: Eco-friendly farming solutions that protect soil, water and crops.
whyChoose.featureAlt: Aerial view of green terraced rice fields
whyChoose.title: Farming Made Easy.
whyChoose.intro: We provide comprehensive, innovative solutions tailored to address the unique challenges faced by modern farmers today.

stories.title: Real farmers, <accent>real harvests.</accent>
stories.intro: See how farmers across Bangladesh grow more and spend less with Agromate's tools and expert advice.

shafiqul.name: Shafiqul Islam
shafiqul.quote: Fertilizer advice from Agromate showed me exactly what my soil needed. I used less urea and still got my best harvest in ten years.

karim.name: Abdul Karim
karim.quote: The weather alert reached me two days before the storm. I cut my paddy early and saved the whole crop.

nurul.name: Nurul Haque
nurul.quote: I photograph a sick plant and get an answer in minutes. Live market prices showed me the best time to sell my jute.

jamal.name: Jamal Uddin
jamal.quote: One phone call with an expert changed how I water my paddy. I use less water now, and my income has doubled.

footer.blurb: Smart and practical solutions to help farmers grow better, work easier and build a stronger future for agriculture.

aboutPage.heroSubtitle: We bring modern farming knowledge, live market prices and weather updates to every farmer in Bangladesh.
aboutPage.storyTitle: Built for the farmers who feed the nation
aboutPage.storyP1: Agromate started with a simple question: why should a farmer have to guess the price of their crop, or find out about a storm too late? Good information exists, but it rarely reaches the field in time.
aboutPage.storyP2: So we built one place where farmers can check daily market prices, plan around the weather and get advice from agriculture experts, in Bangla, on any phone.
aboutPage.storyImageAlt: Farmer checking his tablet in the field

mission.title: Our Mission
mission.text: Give every farmer the information and expert support they need to grow more, waste less and earn a fair price.

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.text: A Bangladesh where farming is profitable, sustainable and respected, powered by simple technology that works for everyone.

farmers.title: Farmers First
farmers.text: Every feature starts with a real problem a farmer faces in the field.

data.title: Data You Can Trust
data.text: Prices and forecasts come from reliable sources and are updated every day.

sustainability.title: Sustainable Growth
sustainability.text: We promote methods that protect soil and water for the next generation.

trust.title: Honest Advice
trust.text: Our experts recommend what works for your farm, not what sells.

supportPage.heroSubtitle: Talk to our agriculture experts by phone, WhatsApp or email, or send us your question below.

cost.a: Market prices and weather updates are free for every farmer. If an expert service has a fee, we will always tell you before you use it.

advice.q: How do I get advice from an expert?
advice.a: Call our helpline, message us on WhatsApp or fill in the form on this page. An agriculture expert will get back to you within 24 hours.

prices.q: Where do the market prices come from?
prices.a: Prices are collected every day from major markets. Prices in your local market may be a little different.

language.q: Can I use Agromate in Bangla?
language.a: Yes. Use the EN | বাং button at the top of any page to switch between English and Bangla.

crops.a: Rice, wheat, potato, vegetables and the most common fertilizers, with more crops being added.

diagnosePage.title: Crop disease check
diagnosePage.intro: Add a photo of the affected part of the plant. The AI recognises the crop and the likely disease, and tells you what to do next.
diagnosePage.resultEmpty: Add a photo on the left and press "Check photo". The AI's answer will show here.

tips.daylight: Shoot in daylight; avoid deep shade and flash.
tips.close: Get close to the affected spot so marks or pests are clearly visible.
tips.sharp: Hold the camera steady; blurry photos can give wrong results.
tips.onePart: Keep one part per photo: a single leaf, fruit or stem.
